A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was the '''father''' of the [[Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling|child]] [[Micah]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], they and [[Micah's mother]] brought Micah to the [[Mirialan]] [[Barriss Offee]] who then instructed the two to take their child to a [[Barriss Offee's friend|friend]] of hers.<ref name="The Way Out" />
